info.title: Enlace Group Loan API
info.description:
API for group lending: onboarding, loans, repayments, trust and credibility.

Documentation layout: **Admin** and **Users** are top-level groups in the sidebar when your viewer supports `x-tagGroups` (e.g. Redoc, Stoplight). Sub-bullets (Dashboard, KYC, …) are OpenAPI tags. **Note:** borrower KYC lives under `/auth/kyc`, `/auth/nin`, `/auth/lookup` (shown as **Users · KYC**). Swagger UI often lists tags flat and alphabetically.

tags.name: Admin · Dashboard
tags.description: Admin home: KPI dashboard (`GET /admin/dashboard`) and cross-entity search (`GET /admin/search`). Requires admin JWT when ADMIN_EMAILS is set.

tags.name: Admin · KYC
tags.description: Admin KYC: counts, list, detail, approve/reject, Mono verify/statement (`/admin/kyc/...`).

tags.name: Admin · Users & groups
tags.description: Admin credit groups and users: summaries, list, export, create group, detail, patch (`/admin/groups/...`, `/admin/users/...`).

tags.name: Admin · Loan operations
tags.description: Admin loan desk: operations dashboard KPIs and tabbed lists (`/admin/loan-operations/...`), loan request queue (`/admin/loan-requests`), workflow status and disburse (`/admin/loans/{id}/status`, `POST /admin/loans/{id}/disburse`).

tags.name: Users · Auth
tags.description: Account lifecycle: signup, login, profile, passwords, invitations, income, loan PIN (`/auth/...` except KYC/NIN/lookup routes).

tags.name: Users · Loans
tags.description: Loan requests, get loan, member approve/reject (`/loans/...` except institutional callback).

201.description: Created. A verification email was sent; user must verify email before logging in.

message.description: e.g. Please verify your email. Check your inbox for the verification link.

post.description: Verifies the user's email using the token sent in the welcome email. The frontend verify-email page (e.g. opened from the link in the email) should read the token from the URL and send it in the request body.

token.description: Verification token from the welcome email

200.description: Email verified. User can now sign in.

400.description: Invalid or expired verification link

post.description: Sends a password reset email if an account exists. Always returns the same message for security.

message.description: If an account exists with this email, we sent a password reset link.

post.summary: Set new password with reset token
post.description: Set a new password using the token from the forget-password email link.

token.description: Reset token from the email link

200.description: Password reset. User can now sign in.

400.description: Invalid or expired reset link

post.description: Change password for the current user. Requires current password.

get.description: Returns invitation details for the link baseUrl/member-invitation/{token}. Use to show the invite page (group name, inviter). type 'signup' = not yet registered; type 'invited' = existing user, must sign in to accept.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Short invitation token from the email link

post.description: Accept the group invitation. For type 'signup': send signup in body (email must match invite); account is created and verify-email is sent. For type 'invited': send Authorization header (logged-in user must be the invitee).

signup.description: Required when invitation type is signup (new user). Email must match the invited email.

400.description: Email must match invite, or signup required, or validation error

401.description: Sign in required to accept (for type invited)

403.description: Invitation was sent to a different account

409.description: Email already has an account; sign in and accept from there

403.description: Email not verified; user must verify email before signing in

post.summary: Submit income (and employment). Recomputes credit limit and group pools.
Set loan PIN once (4 digits). Cannot be set again after it is set.

409.description: Loan PIN has already been set and cannot be changed

post.description: Looks up NIN, sends OTP to phone on NIN record, and stores pending verification server-side.

400.description: NIN lookup failed or invalid data

post.description: Verifies OTP for submitted NIN and saves ninData in user_kyc_data.

400.description: Invalid OTP, expired OTP, or mismatched NIN

get.description: Returns list of banks (Mono lookup/banks). Use nip_code or bank_code when verifying account.

400.description: Bank list lookup failed

post.description: Looks up account name and bank details for the given account number and bank code (Mono lookup/account-number).

400.description: Account lookup failed or invalid request

get.summary: Get KYC status and current step

comment.description: Admin comment (e.g. what to update) when KYC is flagged or under review

put.summary: Submit current KYC step (advances to next step)
put.description: NIN verification is separate under /auth/nin. KYC now has 3 steps: 0 (nin+fullName+address), 1 (account+bvn+code), 2 (employmentDetails).

step.description: Submit verified NIN, set full name, and save address

nin.description: Must match previously verified NIN from /auth/nin/verify

step.description: Submit account details, BVN, and statement code

accountName.description: Must match user fullName or request is rejected

code.description: Code used to fetch bank statement

400.description: Wrong step or validation error

post.summary: Go back to a previous KYC step

400.description: Cannot go back (e.g. already submitted or toStep invalid)

deadline.description: Group deadline (e.g. quarterly end); null if not set

nonAcceptedMemberships.description: Members who have not yet accepted the group invite

get.description: Returns KPIs (portfolio value, active loans, default rate, pending KYC), portfolio growth by week, system alerts, recent loan operations, and distribution by loan type.
Search across users (by fullName or email), loans (by id or amount), and repayments/transactions (by id or loanId).
Total groups, sum of credit limit proxy (COALESCE(maximumAmount, targetCredit)) for ACTIVE groups, and count of groups with derived onboarding status PENDING_KYC.
Same filters as list; returns up to `limit` rows (default 5000) as JSON with Content-Disposition attachment.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search name, group id, display groupId, or initiator

get.description: Paginated directory with initiator, member count, credit limit fields, and derived onboardingStatus for the admin Credit Groups table.

post.description: Same payload as `POST /groups` plus `createdByUserId` (existing user who becomes creator). Sends invites when `members` provided.

400.description: Validation or business rule

patch.description: Partial update: name, description, status, limits, targetCredit.

400.description: Validation

get.description: Search by name, email, or user id. Optional kycStatus and creditStatus filters. Includes active group membership when present.
Profile and memberships; excludes password and sensitive tokens.

Cards: total ACTIVE loans, sum of amounts in APPROVED/REVIEWING/PROCESSING (pending disbursement), repayment rate (PAID / all installments), portfolio value (disbursed lifecycle loans). Change percentages are placeholders (0) until trend data exists.

`tab`: pending_disbursement (APPROVED/REVIEWING/PROCESSING), active (ACTIVE), repayment_schedule (ACTIVE + installments), declined (REJECTED). Search matches borrower name/email, group name, or loan UUID. `disbursementReadiness` and `canDisburse` apply to pending group loans; `canDisburse` requires borrower loan PIN.

400.description: Validation (e.g. missing tab)

post.description: Same as PATCH `/admin/loans/{id}/status` with DISBURSED: group loan only, mandates enforced in service. Requires borrower to have set a loan PIN (`canDisburse` on list).

200.description: Loan disbursed and moved to ACTIVE

400.description: PIN missing, wrong status, or mandate rules

get.description: Paginated list of all loans. Optional filters: `status` (comma-separated LoanStatus), `dateFrom` and `dateTo` (ISO date, filters by createdAt). If `ADMIN_EMAILS` is set, the JWT user email must be in that list.

patch.summary: Set group loan admin workflow status
patch.description: REVIEWING from APPROVED; PROCESSING from APPROVED or REVIEWING; DISBURSED runs disbursement (credit pool, repayment schedule, ACTIVE). Group loans only.

400.description: Invalid transition or not a group loan

get.description: Count user_kyc_data rows. Omit query params to count all. Optional `status` filters by users.kycStatus (User table). Optional `search` by user fullName or email.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by users.kycStatus (PENDING, SUBMITTED, RESUBMITTED, FLAGGED, APPROVED, REJECTED)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by user fullName or email

get.description: Returns all user_kyc_data rows when no filters. Optional `status` filters by users.kycStatus. Optional `search` by user fullName or email.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by users.kycStatus; omit to return all KYC records

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by user fullName or email

kycId.description: Unique KYC record ID (use for details and approve)

get.description: Get full KYC details by kycId. BVN value is not returned; only a bvnProvided flag. A user can have multiple KYC records.

post.description: Approve KYC by kycId. Sets KYC record status to APPROVED, verification flags, and user kycStatus to APPROVED. Use kycId (not userId) because a user can have multiple KYC records.

400.description: KYC already approved or cannot approve rejected KYC

post.description: Reject KYC by kycId. Optionally send comment in body for the user.

400.description: Cannot reject approved KYC

post.description: Verify address via third-party (Mono). Updates kyc_verifications.addressApproved.
Verify credit history via third-party (Mono v3 BVN lookup). Updates kyc_verifications.creditHistoryApproved. If already verified, skips the API call to avoid cost. Requires BVN on the KYC record.

400.description: No BVN on KYC record or BVN decryption failed

get.description: If statement exists in DB for this KYC's user, return it. Otherwise fetch via third-party (Mono), save to DB, and return.

400.description: No linked account to fetch statement

post.description: Verify NIN via third-party (Mono lookup). Updates kyc_verifications.ninApproved.

400.description: No NIN on KYC record

post.description: Creates a group with the caller as creator. Optionally include `members` to add members and send them invite emails (existing users get a group_member invite; new users get a pending group_invite until they sign up).

members.description: Optional list of members to add and send invite emails. Existing users are added as invited members; new users get a pending invite until signup.

400.description: Validation error or invitee already in a group / already invited
Already exited or exit already requested

post.summary: Permanent exit (only when all group loans repaid)

400.description: Cannot exit until group loans repaid

get.summary: Get my direct debit mandate for a group
get.description: Returns the current user's direct debit mandate for the group, if any. Required to be an active group member.

403.description: Not an active member of this group

post.summary: Create mandate (if needed) and send BVN OTP
post.description: Ensures a direct debit mandate exists for the user and group (creates INACTIVE if none), then initiates Mono BVN verification and sends OTP to phone or email. Use mandate.id with the confirm endpoint. Optional body: { "resend": true } to count as resend (throttled once per 3 hours).

200.description: OTP sent; mandate returned for confirm step

400.description: Already have an active mandate, KYC/BVN missing, BVN init or OTP failed, mandate not INACTIVE, or resend throttled

403.description: Not an active member of this group

get.summary: List saved direct-debit accounts for this group
get.description: Returns bank accounts linked for the current user under the group's current lending mandate period (same shape as confirm response accounts), ordered by createdAt descending. Empty array unless the user's latest direct-debit mandate for this group is INPROGRESS or ACTIVE (BVN/accounts flow completed). Also empty if there is no current group mandate period, no member mandate, or no accounts saved. Requires active group membership.

403.description: Not an active member of this group

post.summary: Confirm mandate with OTP and link accounts
post.description: Verify OTP with Mono, fetch BVN-linked bank accounts, create a Mono payment mandate per account and save Account records, then set the direct debit mandate ACTIVE. Response includes all successfully saved linked accounts (use account ids for refresh/verify). mandateId comes from POST /groups/{groupId}/direct-debit-mandate response. Mandate debit cap is derived server-side from the group (max of currentCreditPool and targetCredit; default 1,000,000 NGN if both are zero). Body: otp only.

accounts.description: All bank accounts successfully linked in this confirm call

400.description: Mandate not pending, authorize first, invalid OTP, no BVN accounts, no accounts could be linked via Mono, or Mono customer/create failed

post.summary: Get or refresh Mono payment mandate for a linked account
post.description: Returns the debit account if status is ACTIVE, or if a mandate reference exists and was created less than 3 hours ago. Otherwise calls Mono POST /v3/payments/mandates (same shape as confirm flow), updates reference and initiateMandateData, and resets the account createdAt window. Account must belong to the group and the current user. accountId is returned from confirm (saved Account id).

400.description: Mono initiate failed or account missing bank link

403.description: Not your account or wrong group

post.summary: Verify direct debit mandate status with Mono
post.description: GET Mono v3/payments/mandates/{reference} using the account reference. If approved, sets the account status to ACTIVE. Returns 400 while mandate is still pending approval.

400.description: Mandate pending approval or no reference

403.description: Not your account or wrong group

get.description: Returns loans where the authenticated user is the borrower and the loan is not tied to a group (`groupId` is null). Newest first.

post.description: Create an individual (non-group) loan for the authenticated user. Amount must not exceed the user's credit limit. Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body.

400.description: Amount exceeds credit limit

403.description: Onboarding not complete or invalid PIN

get.description: Returns all loans belonging to the authenticated user's active group(s). Use optional query param `status` to filter by loan outcome/status. Each item may include nested `group` and `borrower` objects. Newest first.

post.description: Create a group loan; all active group members must approve. Each approver must have an active direct debit mandate for the group (within the last 12 months); if not, they must create and authorize a mandate before approving. The loan tenor is validated: the last repayment date (from today + tenorMonths) must fall on or before the current group mandate end date, or the request fails (renew mandate or reduce tenor). Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body.

400.description: Amount exceeds pool/access, KYC incomplete, tenor extends beyond group mandate end date, or no active members

get.description: Return loan details. Allowed for the borrower or for a group member who is an approver for this loan.

post.description: Record the caller's approval for a group loan. Only active group members can approve. For group loans, the approver must have an active direct debit mandate for the group (created and authorized within the last 12 months). If the approver has no running mandate, they must create and authorize direct debit on their account(s) before they can approve. Requires onboarding complete and request body with loanPin (4 digits). When all members have approved, the loan moves to APPROVED and is disbursed.

400.description: Loan not pending approval, already has a rejection, or approver must have an active direct debit mandate for this group (start mandate OTP flow then confirm first)

403.description: Not an active group member, not eligible to approve this loan, or invalid loan PIN

post.summary: Partner callback: continue after institutional approval
post.description: Called by partner/lender when an institutional group loan is approved. Moves loan from INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING to PENDING_APPROVAL and creates pending approval records for group members.

400.description: Loan not INSTITUTIONAL_PENDING

post.description: Record the caller's rejection for a group loan. Only active group members can reject. Requires onboarding complete and loan PIN in body. Once any member rejects, the loan status becomes REJECTED.

400.description: Loan not pending approval or caller already responded

403.description: Not an active group member or invalid loan PIN

400.description: Invalid amount or loan not repayable

pin.description: True if the user has set a loan PIN, false otherwise

runningMandate.description: On profile nested group: true if this user has an ACTIVE direct-debit mandate for this group within the last 12 months

group.description: Nested group details; includes runningMandate on GET /auth/profile

DebitLinkedAccount.description: Bank account linked for group-year direct debit (accounts table)
